purpose.title: What Get Phame does
purpose.description: Get Phame helps local businesses send personalized review-request emails from their own connected email account. It is built for business owners, photographers, cafés and restaurants, home-service teams, clinics and salons, agencies, and WooCommerce stores that want a simpler way to ask real customers for feedback.

steps.send: Send a personal request from your email
steps.reviews: Direct customers to your selected review platform

purpose.googleDescription: Google sign-in is used only to create and identify your Get Phame account. With your permission, Get Phame receives your name and email address. We do not request access to your Gmail messages, contacts, Google Drive files, or Google Calendar.
purpose.googleSendingNote: Review-request sending is configured separately inside the app using an email account you choose to connect.

comparison.description: The big players charge $250–$300/month for review request tools. Get Phame gives you the same core capability at a fraction of the cost. Plus a lifetime option they'll never offer.
comparison.pricingDisclaimer: Prices based on publicly listed entry-tier plans as of April 2026. Subject to change.

faq.a1: Each request is sent through an email account you connect and uses the sender name, address, signature, and message you configure. Preview the message before sending and follow your provider's deliverability guidance.
faq.a6: Messages are sent through the email account you connect, so your provider's sending limits, domain reputation, SPF, DKIM, content, and recipient engagement can affect delivery. No service can guarantee inbox placement.
faq.a9: No. Get Phame provides provider-specific setup guidance for Gmail, Outlook, and other supported SMTP services. Custom SMTP connections require the server address, port, and credentials supplied by your provider.
